rv.q: But if you crave powerful off-Loop theater and support Chicago’s long and proud history of selfless ensemble work, deeply dedicated to honoring actual events and revealing human truths, then “London Road” has so very much to offer.
London Road is an experience unlike anything else you've ever seen onstage.
This U.S. premiere is a triumph for Shattered Globe, but it’s also a show that feels like it needs to be seen.
This is an extraordinary and exceptional piece of theatre.
It’s an unusual stage work and unusually powerful, too.
Although this may seem contradictory at first blush, the idea works rather well.
